subject: Evidence hub access + dataflow mapping request — DPA/Art28-30 deliverables
messages:
From: Acme Health Audit Team <audit@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: sara.nguyen@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence hub access + Art.30 excerpt for DPA review

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this — Acme Health is finalising the onboarding checklist and legal needs an extract of our processing activities to complete the DPIA and sign the DPA (Art. 28/30 confirmation). Our audit team also needs short-term access (read-only) to your evidence portal so we can map subprocessors and confirm onshore hosting options for PHI.

Concrete asks:
- Read-only portal access for audit@acmehealth.com for 7 business days
- An excerpt of the Article 30 register showing processors used for the Acme workload (fields: subprocessors, purpose, data categories, transfer mechanisms)
- A sampling of KMS wrap logs or a redacted log showing envelope-key rotation events for the last 30 days
- Any articulation of onshore vs. offshore processing for the relevant services and an extract of the onshore snapshot if available

Can you confirm timelines and whether we need to sign any additional access addendum? Ideally we’d like access by next Monday (2027-09-20).

Appreciate it — we’re aiming to keep the review scoped to 7 business days.

— Acme Audit Team (Sara Nguyen)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Acme Health Audit Team <audit@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence hub access + Art.30 excerpt for DPA review

Hi Sara / Acme team,

Thanks — we can accommodate this. High-level plan and constraints:

1) Evidence portal access
- We can provision read-only access scoped to the Acme workspace. Access addendum: we require a standard evidence portal NDA (one page) plus the DPA Annex A confirmation; we’ll attach a DocuSign link.
- Lead time: we can create accounts and send invites once the addendum is signed (same day).

2) Article 30 excerpt
- We will produce a PDF extract that includes the processors/subprocessors for Acme’s tenant, purpose descriptions, and transfer mechanism flags (SCCs, onshore). It will be redacted for other customers.
- Format: PDF (art30_register_excerpt.pdf) and a worksheet (DPA_Evidence_Index.xlsx) listing the fields and provenance.

3) KMS logs
- We cannot share raw private keys. We can provide a redacted KMS wrap log sample showing envelope key rotation events and timestamps (kms-wrap-log-sample.csv). This omits key material and customer identifiers beyond tenant id.

4) Onshore snapshot
- We can generate an onshore processing snapshot manifest with node/region mappings and compliance tags (onshore_snapshot_manifest.txt).

Timeline: if the addendum is signed by end of day Monday (2027-09-20), we will enable portal access and upload artifacts within 48 hours (target Wed 2027-09-22). If you need earlier access we can provision provisional tokens under stricter IP restrictions — let us know.

Cc’d: Marissa (privacy ops) — she’ll own the artifact production; Irene (legal) for the access addendum / redaction review; Ben (security) for KMS/Kanary logs.

Next steps:
- Please sign the DocuSign access addendum linked here: DocuSign: 0a7b8c9d-evidence-access-agreement
- Confirm the list of Acme reviewers (names + emails) so we create accounts

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Senior Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, audit@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence hub access + Art.30 excerpt for DPA review

Dylan / team —

Working on the extracts now. A few clarifications from privacy ops to keep expectations aligned:

- Art.30 excerpt will include records of processing activities only for Acme’s tenant and the immediate set of subprocessors (we will not include cross-tenant pipeline details).
- KMS wrap log sample will show envelope IDs and rotation timestamps; it will be scrubbed of tenant email addresses and any IP addresses.
- Onshore snapshot: we will include region-level mapping and a short note on whether the service tier used by Acme has optional onshore-only routing enabled.

Deliverables I’ll upload to the portal: DPA_Evidence_Index.xlsx, art30_register_excerpt.pdf, kms-wrap-log-sample.csv, onshore_snapshot_manifest.txt.

Irene — can you confirm the minimal redaction standard legal wants for Art.30 exports?

Marissa
Privacy Ops

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, audit@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence hub access + Art.30 excerpt for DPA review

Marissa — we should apply the standard minimal redaction: remove any internal hostnames, customer PII (user ids, emails), and exact VM/node IDs. Keep tenant ID (hashed) and processor names. The Art.30 excerpt should include purpose, legal basis, categories of data, retention, and subprocessors.

Additionally: we will require the external auditors to sign the portal addendum and agree to read-only, non-download where feasible. If Acme insists on downloading artifacts, we need DocuSign confirmation and a 30-day access expiration clause.

Ben — please prepare the redacted KMS wrap sample and confirm there are no tokens. We should also include a short security note describing what the KMS sample demonstrates (rotation cadence, wrap/unwrap event types).

Irene
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance

From: sara.nguyen@acmehealth.com <sara.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: audit@acmehealth.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence hub access + Art.30 excerpt for DPA review

Thanks, all — this is helpful. We’ve signed the access addendum (DocuSign completed) and Sara Nguyen (sara.nguyen@acmehealth.com) and audit@acmehealth.com should be provisioned. We do need a downloadable copy for the DPIA team (the legal group wants the PDF and CSVs attached to the DPIA record). If you can set a 7-business-day download window and a watermark on documents we can accept that.

Can you confirm:
- exact expiry date for access once provisioned
- whether the artifact PDFs will be stamped/watermarked with "For Acme Health audit purposes only"
- whether the KMS sample will contain any tenant-identifying strings (you indicated it would be redacted)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you can target Wednesday EOD for the uploads we can start the DPIA run on Thursday.

— Sara
Acme Health, Audit Lead
